name: home-assistant
title: Home Assistant
description: Your Home Assistant entities in the panel with their state: toggle lights, dim, set a temperature, lock a door, run a scene. Every service is a form, and areas list their own entities.
author: pal

settings.label: URL
settings.description: Where Home Assistant answers, scheme included; no trailing slash needed.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A long-lived access token (your profile in HA, Security, Long-lived access tokens). Stored as a keychain: or env: reference.

settings.label: Domains
settings.description: Entity domains listed at the root, in this order. A domain filter shows its domain regardless; favourites are listed regardless.

settings.label: Favourites
settings.description: Entity ids pinned to the top, in this order.

settings.label: Timeout
settings.description: How long one request may take before the row says Home Assistant did not answer.

store.tagline: Toggle, dim and run Home Assistant entities from the panel
features: Every entity at the root with its state (`on`, `locked`, `playing`); favourites first, a filter per domain
The right actions per kind: toggle and dim a light, set a thermostat, open a cover, lock a door, run a scene
Brightness, temperature and volume typed straight into the search bar
Every service as a form, its fields taken from Home Assistant
Areas as lists of their entities; `cmd+o` opens an entity in Home Assistant
A hotkey on any entity toggles it without showing the panel

screenshots.caption: Every entity with its state as a tag and when it last changed, the favourites leading; Enter toggles the light under the cursor
What a light can do: toggle, on, off, set brightness, and the rows every entity has
Show attributes (cmd+shift+A): the thermostat's state and every attribute as a row, Enter copies the value
A service as a form: the target entity, then the fields Home Assistant describes for it, called with Enter
An entity in the detail pane (cmd+I): where it lives, its state as a chip, the reading and the target large, then its attributes

actions.title: Set brightness
actions.description: A light: the percent typed in the bar, light.turn_on with brightness_pct.

actions.title: Set temperature
actions.description: The bar takes a thermostat's temperature (the current one prefilled, its range as the hint) and mode, then climate.set_temperature.

actions.title: Play / Pause, Next track, Previous track, Turn off
Set volume
actions.description: A media player: the percent typed in the bar, media_player.volume_set.

actions.title: Activate / Run / Trigger
actions.description: Scenes, scripts, automations; Enable or Disable for an automation.

actions.title: Copy value
actions.description: Sensors, people and every other domain.

actions.title: Show attributes
actions.description: A level with the state and every attribute; each row copies its value.

actions.title: Open in Home Assistant
actions.description: The automation or script editor, the history page for the rest.

actions.title: Call
actions.description: On a service: the form, then the call.

entities.title: Home Assistant
entities.description: Every entity of the chosen domains with its state, favourites first; the domain filters scope it. Actions per domain: toggle, on, off, brightness, temperature, open, close, lock, play, activate, run, trigger, copy value; every row copies its id, shows its attributes, opens in HA.

keys.title: The domain's first action: toggle, activate, run, copy value
The second: turn on or off, set, pause
Set a light's brightness to the percent typed in the bar
Set a media player's volume to the percent typed in the bar
All entities, Every domain, one domain

services.title: Home Assistant Services
services.description: Every service Home Assistant offers, by domain; Enter opens a form with the target entity and the service's fields, submit calls it.

areas.title: Home Assistant Areas
areas.description: Every area with an entity in it; Enter lists those entities.
